newsitem.title: UK: DMG faces claims of up to 10 mln stg - report.
newsitem.headline: DMG faces claims of up to 10 mln stg - report.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell faces fresh claims of between five and 10 million stg ($8.4 million to $16.8 million) from intermediaries after last year's temporary suspension of three unit trusts, the Daily Telegraph reported on Thursday.
The newspaper said a group of independent financial advisers alleged that financial loss as a result of the Morgan suspension hurting their business.

Last year fund manager Peter Young was sacked for gross misconduct and is currently under investigation by Britain's Serious Fraud Office (SFO) following the discovery of suspect valuations in three MGAM funds. Young has denied any involvement in criminal activity.
The Telegraph article quotes Anthony Yadgaroff of London-based firm Allenbridge saying in total advisers had lost between five and 10 million stg.
A Morgan Grenfell spokesman said in the report the company had not yet taken any view on whether compensation should be payable to advisers.
